# Investigating the Coronavirus Pandemic (Skeleton Notebook)

Welcome! In this project, you will practice data loading, filtering, aggregating, transposing wide-format data, and visual analysis using R.
Load `dplyr`, `readr`, and `janitor`. Read `corona_confirmed.csv`, `corona_recovered.csv`, and `corona_deaths.csv` into separate variables.

library(readr)
